patch.value: Declare renderer ownership so the host enforces scoping the package only applied at runtime

The renderer overrides self-scoped by checking a private result marker and returning null, which is correct but invisible to the host. Passing the ownership argument makes commands and result ownership enforced before the callback runs.

Both renderer registrations pass a shared ownership object naming the package's own commands and its result discriminator; a test proves the renderer still renders its own marked result and declines a foreign one; coverage stays at 100

value.text: Derived command paths from the ten api.registerCommand({ name }) calls in index.ts: ops scan (2424), ops policy (2457), ops verify-release (2513), ops report (2582), ops status (2619), ops outdated (2650), ops audit (2680), ops metrics (2710), ops merge-receipts (2785), ops docstrings (2861). All ten commands can return a pmOpsRendered-marked result, either directly via renderedCommandResult() or through the shared emitResult() helper. The resultDiscriminator reuses the extracted isRenderedCommandResult predicate.
